newsitem.title: JAPAN: Oriental Land weighted average price set at Y8,368.
newsitem.headline: Oriental Land weighted average price set at Y8,368.

text.p: The weighted average auction price of Oriental Land Co Ltd's shares was set at 8,368 yen, the Tokyo Stock Exchange (TSE) said on Wednesday.
The lowest bid price for Oriental Land's stock auction held on Wednesday was 7,820 yen, while the highest bid price was 14,000 yen, the TSE said.
The lowest price was mostly in line with market expectations of around 8,000 yen.
Oriental Land said earlier this month that the minimum auction offer price for its shares was set at 5,220 yen.

Out of all 30.931 million shares auctioned, bids for 11.5 million were accepted. Oriental Land, which operates Tokyo Disneyland, will be listed on the first section of the Tokyo Stock Exchange on December 11.
